data.title: Health insurer requests more documents for knee surgery invoice
data.summary: Beispiel Krankenversicherung a.G. wrote on 30 September 2025 asking for the operation report and the physiotherapy prescription for your knee surgery invoice of 12 September 2025. They must arrive by the 7th working day after the letter date.
data.explanation: Your private health insurer needs two documents to check your doctor's invoice for the outpatient knee operation: the operation report (OP-Bericht) and the physiotherapy prescription (Verordnung). Send them by the deadline shown. The insurer counts working days as Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays. If they don't arrive in time, the insurer will only reimburse the items that are documented. Ask your doctor or hospital for the documents now if you don't have them.

items.title: Send operation report and physiotherapy prescription

date.text: spätestens am 7. Arbeitstag nach dem Briefdatum; Arbeitstage sind für uns Montag bis Freitag ohne gesetzliche Feiertage

items.action: Send the operation report (OP-Bericht) and the physiotherapy prescription (Verordnung) to the insurer.
